comparison.objective: Place the last cake slice on plate number 1 rather than the nearest plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Read a symbolic label and perform basic pick-and-place.
comparison.success_condition: Cake rests within 6.5 cm of plate 1 centre and at the proper height; otherwise zero.
comparison.reason: This is semantic target selection plus pick-and-place and lacks the candidate's contact-rich tooling, fracture, damage controls, and fragment accounting.
